mathematical_meanings: Left image: The trace is the graph of a periodic function whose marked points indicate a trough and a peak. Right image: The oscillating line is the graph of a periodic function.
Rationales: In both images the feature traces a repeating function graph. The cyan wave with marked extrema at (−π/2, 2.4) and (3π/2, 13). The cyan curve with several similar peaks and the labeled low point (1, 1.5).
